query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN p.ativo = 1 THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END as item_status,
  COUNT(*) as obs_count
FROM cobranca_etapa_obs o
JOIN cobranca_planilha p ON o.planilha_id = p.id
GROUP BY item_status;
